1.

"God is love." In Jesus Christ This love took a full form; And the love that gave up the Son Shall also with Him bestow all upon us. Christ once, in grace, forsook Heaven’s bliss and came to earth, Yes, for us, who were prisoners of death, He took upon Himself God’s righteous judgment.

2.

"God is love"; may that song resound Over the earth from pole to pole; May it penetrate into many hearts, Until they melt before the sun of God’s love! "God is love"; yes, He loves eternally, Loves faithfully, desires to be loved in return. Who can close their heart to His love, Who would not love this Friend!
